bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
SQL="SELECT 'PIN_UPDATE_MINUTE='||to_char(date_trunc('minute',updated_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')||' COUNT='||count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE state='published' GROUP BY date_trunc('minute',updated_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('minute',updated_at); SELECT 'PANEL_UPDATE_MINUTE='||state||' '||to_char(date_trunc('minute',updated_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')||' COUNT='||count(*) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' GROUP BY state,date_trunc('minute',updated_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('minute',updated_at); SELECT 'PANEL_NEEDS_RECONCILE='||chat_id||':'||message_thread_id||':'||message_id FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' AND state='needs_reconcile';"
RESULT=$(docker compose -p deploy -f "$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$SQL" 2>&1) || exit 32
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "$(printf 'POSTING_MENU_EDIT_MINUTE_DIST_FIXED_20261113\n%s' "$RESULT")" >/dev/null || exit 33
echo POSTING_MENU_DISTRIBUTION_RECORDED
